sloka: तस्य तेन प्रतिज्ञातं सीतायाः परिमार्गणम् ।सुग्रीवस्यापि रामेण हरिराज्यं निवेदितम् ।। ५.५१.९।।।।
transliteration: tasya tena pratijñātaṁ sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam ।sugrīvasyāpi rāmeṇa harirājyaṁ niveditam ।। 5.51.9।।।।

translations.english: "Sugriva promised Rama to undertake search for Sita and Rama assured Sugriva of securing him the kingdom of the monkeys.
